title: 跨 Web/Native 边界保留原生资源身份
summary: 浏览器 File、Android content URI、持久授权、本机 font pool 等不是同一种资源身份；跨桥接层时应保留原始原生句柄/URI 或受控副本，而不是从显示名称或 JavaScript 路径重建。
principles: Browser File identity and native content URI identity are distinct.
Persistable URI grants or controlled app-private copies are explicit native persistence mechanisms.
Native font persistence is separate from browser IndexedDB persistence even when UI semantics are shared.
Temporary protocol registrations are owned by one job and unregistered on every terminal path.
Non-seekable content providers require probe/fallback-copy policy instead of assuming local-file semantics.

provenance.note: SAF lifecycle, URI identity, native font pool, non-seekable providers.
